pages.text: Build your own spells, glyph by glyph — Ars Nouveau is the Tier 2 magic mod: custom spell crafting, familiars, and magical automation.

$(bold)Role in the pack:$() Ars Nouveau is the Battlemage and Archmage's natural home at Tier 2. The glyph-based spell system allows building custom spells tailored to your class's strengths.$(br2)$(bold)Source generation:$() Ars Nouveau uses Source as its resource. Source Jars and Sourcelinks are the T2 mana automation backbone.

$(bold)Faefolk synergy:$() +10% spell power from the Nature Magic racial. Ars Nouveau's nature-flavored spells benefit the most.$(br2)$(bold)What unlocks at T2:$() Full spellbook access, Bookwyrm familiar, Drygmy for mob farming, Whirlisprig for crop automation. These become available once you have T2 stage.

$(bold)Where the reference lives:$() this Codex replaces the individual mod guidebooks in this pack. Every glyph and apparatus recipe is in JEI; the T1 entry path is walked in $(l:icraft:mods_t1/early_magic)Early Magic Tutorial$(/l).$(br2)$(bold)Keys:$() $(k:ars_nouveau.open_book) opens your spell book's editor; $(k:ars_nouveau.previous_slot)/$(k:ars_nouveau.next_slot) switch spell slots.$(br2)$(bold)Next: inscribe your first custom spell at a Scribes Table.$()
